Two days until Battle of the Tech Bands Sydney. The Canvanauts came within five votes of winning last year's crowd vote, and this is their heavy take on Taylor Swift's Anti-Hero from the Factory Theatre.

Canva's band are back on Thursday 8 October at Manning Bar.
